picks.catalyst: Gap down: agreed to buy Zscaler in a $43.9B all-stock deal
picks.why: CrowdStrike is buying rival Zscaler by paying with its own shares (1.135 CRWD shares per ZS share, a 34% premium), so it's down roughly 8% before the open as holders worry about the price and share dilution; this hurts sentiment, not the business, so a big name like this can bounce once early sellers finish. No reliable pre-market price found, so use the live quote and wait for the desk's trigger.
